# Branch: c/exciting-tesla-948qt6

Implements **UI-001**: `ui` must serve the dashboard on loopback and open
the operator's browser.

API-001 landed the loopback RPC server, its verbs, and SSE job streaming in
`internal/api`. UI-001 is the other half of that surface: a `ui` command
that serves the dashboard from the same loopback origin as the API and
points the operator's browser at it.

Work:

1. **`web/`** — the dashboard, plain static assets embedded via `go:embed`.
   No framework, no build toolchain, no CDN: one static binary with zero
   runtime dependencies (spec.md "Language") means the page has to be
   servable exactly as it sits in the tree. No stack decision is required
   for UI-001 because nothing is chosen.
2. **`internal/core/ui`** — serves the dashboard and the API handler on one
   loopback listener, and opens the operator's browser at the served URL.
   Dashboard routes are `GET /` and `GET /ui/...`; everything else falls
   through to the API handler, so the RPC verbs keep their spec'd paths and
   the page talks to them same-origin.
3. **`cmd/farrier ui`** — flag parsing only, per house patterns.

Scope is UI-001 alone. UI-002 (status, replication lag, backup history,
drill results, promotion) stays open; the shell served here holds no views
and reaches into no core package, so UI-002 adds views against the API
without tearing anything up.

See `docs/functional-requirements.md` § UI and `docs/status.json`.

This file exists for conductor tracking and can be deleted once the PR
merges.
